intro_html: Keeps a tamper-evident record of who did what to which record — every create, edit, delete, read, or export, with the old and new value for every changed field — so "who changed this, and what was it before?" always has an answer.

features.title: Field-by-Field History
features.desc: Every changed field logged with a readable old value and new value — not just "something changed".

features.title: Fast Mode for Busy Models
features.desc: Switch to lightweight logging on high-traffic models where speed matters more than full history.

features.title: Deleted-Record Snapshots
features.desc: Keep every field's value from right before a record is deleted, not just that it happened.

features.title: Export Tracking
features.desc: Know exactly which records were exported, by whom, with one click back to the records themselves.

features.title: Exclude the Noise
features.desc: Leave out specific users or fields so the trail stays relevant, not cluttered.

features.title: Multi-Company Aware
features.desc: Each log stays scoped to the companies a user is actually allowed to see.

features.title: Built-in Cleanup
features.desc: Auto-purge old logs on a schedule, or run cleanup on demand — your retention, your call.

features.title: Multilingual Out of the Box
features.desc: Ships fully translated in English, Ukrainian, and Polish.

limitations: Logging every read is expensive on high-traffic models (like Contacts) — best turned on only for sensitive, low-volume ones.
Fast mode trades away the "before" value — it shows what was written, not what it replaced.
Automatic cleanup ships switched off; you turn it on if you want logs purged on a schedule.
Changes made outside Odoo (direct database edits) aren't captured.
